text.p: This view shows the dynamic memory allocation over time, i.e. the malloc() and free() calls and the sum of the allocations made. If you click on a marker in the graph you can see information about that event in the information panel. Double-clicking on a marker will focus the Trace View on that event.

Note that memory allocation events also can be viewed in the Object History view, by double-clicking on the event in the Trace View. This includes a filtering feature that makes it easier to spot memory leaks.

This may include multiple memory heaps in the system, if present, for example if the RTOS provides "byte pool" and/or "block pool" objects where allocations can be made. You can show or hide such heap objects by clicking on their entries in the legend field to the right.
